title: EU-banned pesticides found in rice, tea and spices
summary: Investigative report by foodwatch exposing the presence of EU-banned pesticides in common food products including rice, tea, and spices, revealing significant gaps in food safety regulation and import controls.
problem_solved: Exposes food safety violations where banned pesticides from non-EU countries enter the European food supply through insufficient testing and regulatory enforcement.
why_valuable: Raises critical public awareness about consumer protection failures and the disconnect between EU pesticide bans and actual food imports, enabling informed consumer choices and policy pressure.
